assessment.security_status_en: Global tech markets and supply chains face intense pressure following the disruptive entry of China's DeepSeek AI model, which triggered a sharp sell-off across US and Asian technology sectors. Regional geopolitical tensions remain elevated due to China's new defense mobilization measures and persistent friction around Taiwan and the South China Sea. Meanwhile, the Japanese and South Korean economies are grappling with domestic structural changes, including sweeping stock index reforms and monetary policy challenges.

Regional geopolitical tensions remain elevated due to China's new defense mobilization measures and persistent friction around Taiwan and the South China Sea. Meanwhile, the Japanese and South Korean economies are grappling with domestic structural changes, including sweeping stock index reforms and monetary policy challenges.
